steps.title: Welcome to Campaignia
steps.text: This is your campaigns home. Each card is one campaign — the world your sessions and graphic novel live inside.

steps.title: Start a campaign
steps.text: Click here to create your first campaign. You can name it, describe it, and give it a cover image later.
